approach: Split doctor's repair field into a runnable command plus a prose instruction, decided on the consumer axis: TOON is the default format and an agent is the default consumer, so the executable/judgment distinction belongs in the data rather than in prose formatting.
Revise one existing node (cli/configuration-diagnosis); create none. A concurrent mission owns the shared report-shape node and was mailed the decision before any code was written.
Blast radius: one package, four source modules and one generated skill, no published API beyond the report shape the CR exists to change.

what: Two scenarios in the configuration-diagnosis suite reach the same decision point by path classes whose outcomes never diverge — a tracked bridge and a directory that is not a git repository both end in no ignored-bridge fault, with no distinguishing downstream consequence. Either they collapse into one reconvergent scenario or the path classes need a consequence that actually differs. Pre-existing; untouched by this change request, and surfaced by the spec-judge as an architect observation rather than a gate failure.
